headline: New Jersey lets BPU demand data center usage reports
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

New Jersey gives the BPU the power to demand semi-annual water and energy usage reports from data center owners and operators. Passed.

108 measures in 20 jurisdictions would require a company to file reports with a government body, or hand them over on demand.

163 measures in 38 jurisdictions cite the fear that anyone can now fake anyone.

2,007 measures tracked. 389 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 82 offices.
